text:
incident-bot: Incident created: P1 - GPU OOM spike on serving runtime causing container restarts. Affected model: rwd-llama-13b-v2 (prefill path). Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/1769123456 :rotating_light:

mia_oncall: paging in — I'm on call, seeing alerts. Starting triage now. Which customer(s) reporting errors? @simon_ce any customer reports?

simon_ce: getting manual reports from acct-team: ~3 customers seeing 502s and timeouts, one enterprise customer seeing degraded QPS. They call it "long prompt batch" from their UI.

raj_infra: logs from pod serving-172 show repeated OOM logs during prefill: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.1 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total)`. Containers restarted 4x in last 10m. Node gpu-12 shows high resident GPU memory and occasional kernel resets.

elena_sre: root cause hypothesis: prefill requests with very large context windows + aggressive prefetching growth the KV cache during prefill path, pushing model beyond reserved memory. We see long prefix lengths (~45k tokens estimated) in the request metadata.

mia_oncall: immediate mitigations I will apply: 1) set route config max_prefill_tokens=8192 (previously unlimited), 2) enable stream-trim for long-prefill routes, 3) add fallback to quantized-variant (rwd-llama-13b-q4). Rolling these changes now.

raj_infra: evicting KV cache on affected pods, restarting pod set serving-172 with graceful drain. Also cordoned node gpu-12 to stop new placements while we inspect.

ops-bot: deploy config patch applied to svc/serving-routes (change max_prefill_tokens=8192). 5/6 pods updated successfully, pod serving-178 still failing to come up due to repeated kernel crash.

elena_sre: throttling prefill concurrency for the tier to 1 in nginx-ingress, will reduce rate of simultaneous heavy prefill work until autoscale policy is tuned.

simon_ce: messaging to customers: "We observed a subset of long-context prefill requests causing GPU memory exhaustion and container restarts. We've rolled mitigations (prefill limits, streaming trim, quantized fallback). Impact: ~10-15% of requests for a small set of routes experienced errors for ~30-40 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and permanent fix." Sending now. :envelope_with_arrow:

mia_oncall: creating handoff notes for night oncall @linda_noc — leaving the exact commands and rollback steps in this thread. Key checks: pod restarts, kernel resets in dmesg, node cordon state, customer error rate.

linda_noc: ack taking over in 30m. Please leave the runbook snippets. Also tag the postmortem ticket.

mia_oncall: runbook snippet (commands):
```
# evict KV cache for a deployment
kubectl exec -it svc/serving-routes -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/evict_cache

# set route config via controlplane API
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood/api/routes/serving-route/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"max_prefill_tokens":8192, "enable_stream_trim":true, "fallback_model":"rwd-llama-13b-q4"}'

# cordon and drain node
kubectl cordon gpu-12
kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

raj_infra: created ticket INC-2026-432 (postmortem placeholders, owner: @raj_infra). Will attach logs and kernel traces.

mia_oncall: leaving notes: next steps for eng-runtime: prevent KV growth during prefill (patch planned), add early-size checks on prefill path, and surface request token-length on dashboards to auto-block extreme requests.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to P1 -> mitigated. Monitoring for recurrence for 2h.

linda_noc: took over at 1769130056 — all current mitigations still in place. I'll monitor and escalate if restarts resume. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
